Label the pre-flight block explicitly as nonce/identity route-health checks and keep it visually separate from the distinct Run Sample investigation action below.
Increase route-select text to 13px and add a focus-visible outline; keep offline/no-network status as text plus marker, not dot alone.
Move the no-model-yet status into the DecisionBar centre so the primary Run Sample investigation is the sole neon action.

Keep typed consent form tied to the selected path and show phrase, character count and expiry together; enable Accept only when the exact phrase matches, with aria-live result.

Show the accepted 40+30=70 route split on the SVG connectors to JOB-1001 and JOB-1002, not only MAT-ALLOY-B · 70 parts.

State in the DecisionBar centre exactly what Apply second shock invalidates before activation, and move Scenario Management/admin reset out of the main flow.
Make the machine selector a labelled 40px control with keyboard focus ring and preview summary tied to the selected cell.
Preserve the red exception strictly on CELL-MILL-2: cross-hatch, OFFLINE text and outline; remove red tint from the full-width shock banner.
Keep pre-flight nonce/identity route-health separate from the Reinvestigate recovery evidence task, with separate headings and status lines.
Annotate the two remaining feasible paths directly on the SVG and dim the constrained Split option with its reason.
Fix inspector top clipping again and keep the constrained Split row fully readable: reason, unavailable finish/cost shown as — with text explanation.
In the typed consent form, pair the fresh APPROVE phrase with Scenario changed · review required and prior-acceptance-invalidated status adjacent to the input.
Use radio semantics for the three paths matching Step 3, with the selected revised path announced via aria-live only on change.
Keep Prior tracked: 3 BLOCKED expanded or one-click expandable beside the approved revised plan, while replacement t1–t3 remain PROPOSED · UNTRACKED UNTIL APPROVAL.
Add BLOCKED pattern/marker to the prior-work summary in the legend language so state is not colour-only.
Confirm DecisionBar status Approved revised plan · replacement tasks await approval stays visible until Approve revised tasks is activated.
Remove inspector vertical scrollbar overflow at 1366x768 by grouping Seal/Verify/Retain as three equal action cards inside the internal scroll area with sticky completion status.
Separate Verify ledger (DecisionBar primary) from Export independent checkpoint actions and label each Awaiting/Complete state with marker plus text.
Enlarge passphrase helper text to 12px and show 16–160 character rule before typing, without implying custody guarantees.
Replace the rail checkmark-only completion item with Recovery story complete text plus aria-current, matching the 9-step rail pattern.
Keep PACKET SEALED · 18 events · revised plan accepted in the DecisionBar and make Review recovery proof open a proof summary, not restart verification.
